theme: plate lockdown PARSESIZE budget CHMOD MODE HUMANSIZE secret gate

tests.name: chmod_strvar_fix
tests.cmd: SYS CHMOD fp m with m=0600 → 384 not strlen 4

weaknesses.title: CHMOD string-var used parse_expr strlen (FIXED this iter)
weaknesses.detail: SYS CHMOD fp m with m="0600" applied mode 4 (strlen) not octal 384. Literals worked; DEFAULT/LET modes silently mis-locked plates to -------r--. Fixed: string idents parse as octal.
weaknesses.repro: pre-fix: LET m="0600"; CHMOD fp m → MODE 0004

weaknesses.title: HUMANSIZE↔PARSESIZE asymmetric after floor
weaknesses.detail: HUMANSIZE 1536 → 1K; PARSESIZE 1K → 1024. Budget round-trips lose bytes. Agents that label then re-parse shrink ceilings.

weaknesses.title: Bare DEFAULT NQ = 0600 is decimal 600 not octal
weaknesses.detail: Unquoted 0600 becomes 600 decimal; CHMOD then sets 1130 octal. Only quoted "0600" is safe octal mode text.

weaknesses.title: WRITE plate metas omit trailing NL
CHMOD success does not re-stat for umask/ACL surprises
weaknesses.detail: CHMOD_N reports requested mode bits; host may still differ under restricted FS. Board re-MODE after lock as workaround.

weaknesses.title: PARSESIZE rejects fractional labels (1.5K)
weaknesses.detail: Only integer+unit; agents with SI 1.5K configs soft-fail.

weaknesses.title: put gates on LEN(body) not SIZE after write
weaknesses.detail: Correct for pure text; binary/WRITE NL mismatch could diverge. No atomic size-check-after-write retry.

workarounds: Always quote mode strings "0600"; never bare 0600 DEFAULT
Compare budgets with PARSESIZE_N/SIZE not HUMANSIZE labels
Prefer string vars post-fix for lock mode ARG
language_gaps: Octal number literals 0o600 / leading-zero octal policy
HUMANSIZE fractional / ceil mode for round-trip
